# Complex line pattern fixture

`complex-literal-ac1032.dxf` is manually authored DXF group data, independent of
the codec writer. It declares text-relative flags 2, shape-absolute flags 5,
shape selector 42 and resolved ordinary/shape STYLE records. Group 50 is degrees
on disk (0.25 and -0.5 radians); offsets are -1 and 2, marker scale 0.1. The
zero-length marked element is a marker placement, not an additional dot.
The SHX file is deliberately external and is not required for native validity.
